domain: Whether the value of institutional memory in organizations is best understood at the level of policy, or only becomes visible in the specific habits of a single retiring employee
topic: Whether the value of institutional memory in organizations is best understood at the level of policy, or only becomes visible in the specific habits of a single retiring employee

movement.gist: Open at the widest level: organizations everywhere worry about the loss of accumulated know-how when experienced people leave, and invest heavily in systems meant to capture it.

Narrow to the specific domain of industrial knowledge transfer — succession planning and 'knowledge capture' initiatives in manufacturing plants facing retirements of veteran line workers, and the standard toolkit (shadowing, documentation, exit interviews) used to preserve their expertise.

Narrow further to a single case: a specific chemical-processing plant preparing for the retirement of Marguerite, its senior batch operator of thirty-one years, and the elaborate six-month handoff process designed around her, including a junior engineer assigned to document her every judgment call.

Go inside that case: the documentation effort succeeds at capturing her explicit rules but fails to capture the specific, almost unnoticed gesture by which she rests her hand on a valve housing to feel a vibration pattern that predicts overheating three shifts before any gauge would show it — a practice she cannot fully articulate even to herself, was never taught to her, and which the plant's own safety record turns out to depend on far more than anyone had assumed; this is where the real thesis about tacit, unlanguaged expertise surfaces.

primary.axis: Where institutional knowledge actually resides — in codified procedure or in uncodifiable individual practice
poles: the tacit, undocumented judgment of one long-serving worker

secondary.axis: Whether the retiring worker's value is a cause of organizational stability or merely a symptom of it
poles: her judgment produces the plant's low error rate
the plant's stable conditions are what allowed her judgment to accumulate undisturbed

tension_system.interaction: The secondary tension supplies the causal-direction trap that the case interior paragraph exploits, while the primary tension is the one the ending actually relocates.

family_realization.note: Opens at 'every organization' (widest), narrows through industrial toolkit → Lorraine case → Marguerite's hand → vibration signature (narrowest). Thesis lodged at narrow end (para 4). Difficulty precise: reader weighting opening generality risks choosing adjacent answers (Q1B, Q3D). Returns never happen.

ending_behavior.note: Final paragraph reframes from 'did handoff capture?' to 'what else in that building was held together by unnamed gestures?' Aperture explicitly widens; question left unanswered. Q8 tests whether reader absorbs reframing stance.

voice_consistency.note: Provocative claim ('vessels fail silently') defended with pedantic precision (nine hundred decisions, three shifts, two exchanges in fourteen months, four documented near-misses). One stubborn particular: right palm on number-three feed valve. Concession-hedging shows human texture, not preachy.

distractor_efficiency.note: Q1B (adjacent_answer: patience as fix when the case proves patience insufficient). Q2C (stage_misattribution: author's reconstruction palmed as plant-era knowledge). Q3C (author explicitly refuses causation). Q4A (already conceded in passage). Q5B (author already brackets causation). Traps require reading comprehension, not lexical extremity.

explanation_quality.note: Every wrong option identified by mechanism with passage location: 'paragraph 3 describes design as matching her value', 'paragraph 4 explicitly refuses this claim', 'paragraph 2 concedes toolkit captures'. No 'not mentioned' or generic extremity dismissals. Precise.

answers.reasoning: Passage argues capture systems miss unnamed practices sustaining performance, per closing question.
Text states design assumed expertise was statable rules elicitable by patient questioning.
Author calls decomposition belief sufficient/intelligent but ultimately shows it incomplete, not endorsed fully.
Confirms no instrument duplicated her function, strengthening the paragraph's claim about unnamed capability.
If unnamed habits were routinely surfaced, the core problem of unrecorded tacit knowledge disappears.
Paragraph explicitly grants apparatus strongest rationale before later critique via Lorraine case.
Author explicitly refuses to claim causation, only correlation/interruption evidence, per stated text.
Parallels Marguerite case: manual captures articulable knowledge, missing unnamed routines needing search.
